messages:
Tara (infra): Heads-up: scheduling a rolling soft-reboot for the 'reef' GPU pool in us-west2 on Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Reason: NIC microcode + BIOS thermal calibration. No PSU cycles.
Owen (sre): Acknowledged. Expected capacity impact?
Tara (infra): ~9-12% at peak. Plan: drain -> soft-reboot -> health-check -> uncordon. Parallelism=3, cadence ~1 node / 80s.
Ira (oncall): Need warm spares seeded to avoid KV misses. Also add MTU sanity checks post-reboot.
Ned (scheduler): Reserving 7 warm GPUs (reef-warm). Seeding cmd: `ops/seed_cache --pool=reef-warm --prefixes=hotkeys --concurrency=4` 75m pre-window.
Lina (support): Draft customer blurb: "Planned maintenance in us-west2 may cause short latency spikes and minor capacity throttling 02:00-04:00 UTC. No data loss expected." Posting after approvals.
Owen (sre): Canary: 1 node, 5% traffic for 10m. Gates: p95 < baseline+35ms, error-rate <0.6%. If breach -> stop & rollback microcode.
Tara (infra): Will set routing hint to avoid nodes with uptime <5m (`route_avoid_recent_boot=true`). Also enable cross-region fallback to eu-west for latency-sensitive tenants.
Ira (oncall): Paging rule: free GPUs <5 for >5m -> page; KV miss >9% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets -> page.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: "reef maintenance in 24h" posted to #eng-infra and #oncall.
Tara (infra): Ops timeline: 00:45 seed caches; 01:50 smoke tests; 02:00 canary reboot; 02:12 evaluate; 02:20 ramp with max_parallel=3; finish ~03:40; cooldown 04:00.
Ned (scheduler): Job `reef-soft-restart-v1` queued (dry-run OK).
Lina (support): Cost est: ~$1.4k for warmbackfill + IO. Finance ok.
Tara (infra): React :thumbsup: to acknowledge; will flip infra-bot reminders to 2h and 15m.
Ira (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll be standby 01:45-04:15 and join if canary trips.
Owen (sre): :thumbsup: prepping rollback scripts and temporary dashboard.
